text: SILL Entreprises (SIREN 636220220, SAS, Plouvien, RCS Brest 636 220 220) says it began in 1962 at Plouvien and calls itself a longstanding family business. The club's partner page says the SILL (Société Industrielle Laitière du Léon) was created in 1962 by two families of butter merchants, the Falc'hun and León families. The company register lists Sébastien Floch as Président de SAS, with Tristan Falc'hun and Henri León as Directeurs Généraux.
short: SILL Entreprises, founded in 1962 by the Falc'hun and León families, calls itself a family business.

source.name: Annuaire des entreprises (recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr), SILL ENTREPRISES, SIREN 636220220
source.note: Same response: FLOCH Sébastien Alain Olivier is Président de SAS and LEON Henri is the second Directeur Général; nature juridique 5710 (SAS), siège Plouvien (29860).

additionalSources.name: Accueil – Sill Entreprises
additionalSources.quote: SILL Entreprises began back in 1962 in a Breton town called Plouvien. As a longstanding family business bringing together a strong group of SMEs, SILL Entreprises is ready to take on whatever the future holds.
